components.name: Shelf
components.description: The signature: one spine per day in four states (gold, plain leather, empty dashed, none); the newest slot stamps gold in place.
components.css: .ds-hue-shacharit{--hue:var(--leather-shacharit,#1f4d3a);--hue-deep:#1f4d3a} .ds-hue-mincha{--hue:var(--leather-mincha,#7a2430);--hue-deep:#7a2430} .ds-hue-maariv{--hue:var(--leather-maariv,#1e3355);--hue-deep:#1e3355} .ds-hue-musaf{--hue:var(--leather-musaf,#5b3a6b);--hue-deep:#5b3a6b} .ds-hue-torah{--hue:var(--leather-torah,#6b4423);--hue-deep:#6b4423} .ds-shelf{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;gap:3px;height:24px} .ds-spine{display:block;width:6px;height:22px;border-radius:1.5px;background:var(--hue)} .ds-spine-gold{box-shadow:inset 0 4px 0 var(--gold,#a87a1f),inset 0 -4px 0 var(--gold,#a87a1f)} .ds-spine-empty{box-sizing:border-box;border:1px dashed var(--app-label-secondary,rgba(60,60,67,.75));background:transparent} .ds-spine-none{background:transparent} .ds-spine-stamp{animation:ds-stamp 220ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1)} @keyframes ds-stamp{from{box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 var(--gold,#a87a1f),inset 0 0 0 var(--gold,#a87a1f)}} @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-spine-stamp{animation:none}}

components.name: Ruled Table

components.css: .ds-hue-shacharit{--hue:var(--leather-shacharit,#1f4d3a);--hue-deep:#1f4d3a} .ds-hue-mincha{--hue:var(--leather-mincha,#7a2430);--hue-deep:#7a2430} .ds-hue-maariv{--hue:var(--leather-maariv,#1e3355);--hue-deep:#1e3355} .ds-hue-musaf{--hue:var(--leather-musaf,#5b3a6b);--hue-deep:#5b3a6b} .ds-hue-torah{--hue:var(--leather-torah,#6b4423);--hue-deep:#6b4423} .ds-ruled{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;border-radius:10px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--ion-item-background,#fff);color:var(--app-label,#000);font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', 'Helvetica Neue', 'Arial Hebrew', sans-serif;font-size:1.0625rem;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums} .ds-ruled th,.ds-ruled td{padding:11px 16px;border-bottom:.5px solid var(--app-separator,rgba(60,60,67,.29));text-align:start;font-weight:400} .ds-ruled td{text-align:end;font-weight:600} .ds-ruled thead th{font-size:.8125rem;color:var(--app-label-secondary,rgba(60,60,67,.75));text-align:end} .ds-ruled tr:last-child th,.ds-ruled tr:last-child td{border-bottom:0} .ds-key{display:inline-block;margin-inline-end:10px;vertical-align:middle;width:5px;height:18px;border-radius:1px;background:var(--hue);box-shadow:inset 0 3px 0 var(--gold,#a87a1f),inset 0 -3px 0 var(--gold,#a87a1f)}

components.name: Month Grid Cell
components.description: Day button: Gregorian number, Hebrew day letter, then one small spine per applicable prayer plus Torah; today sits in a 30px leather circle.
components.css: .ds-hue-shacharit{--hue:var(--leather-shacharit,#1f4d3a);--hue-deep:#1f4d3a} .ds-hue-mincha{--hue:var(--leather-mincha,#7a2430);--hue-deep:#7a2430} .ds-hue-maariv{--hue:var(--leather-maariv,#1e3355);--hue-deep:#1e3355} .ds-hue-musaf{--hue:var(--leather-musaf,#5b3a6b);--hue-deep:#5b3a6b} .ds-hue-torah{--hue:var(--leather-torah,#6b4423);--hue-deep:#6b4423} .ds-month{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(7,minmax(0,1fr));gap:4px;padding:10px 8px 12px;border-radius:10px;background:var(--ion-item-background,#fff);font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', 'Helvetica Neue', 'Arial Hebrew', sans-serif} .ds-day{display:grid;justify-items:center;align-content:start;gap:1px;min-height:62px;padding:2px 0 6px;border:0;border-radius:8px;background:transparent;color:var(--app-label,#000);font:inherit} .ds-day:active{background:var(--app-fill,rgba(118,118,128,.12))} .ds-day:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--ion-color-primary,#8a5a12);outline-offset:-2px} .ds-num{display:grid;place-items:center;width:30px;height:30px;font-size:1.0625rem;font-weight:500;line-height:1} .ds-day.is-today .ds-num{border-radius:50%;background:var(--leather-band,#2b2320);color:var(--gold-leaf,#e2c27a);font-weight:700} .ds-heb{font-size:.6875rem;line-height:1.2;color:var(--app-label-secondary,rgba(60,60,67,.75))} .ds-spines{display:flex;gap:2px;margin-top:4px} .ds-s{display:block;width:4px;height:14px;border-radius:1px;background:var(--hue)} .ds-g{box-shadow:inset 0 3px 0 var(--gold,#a87a1f),inset 0 -3px 0 var(--gold,#a87a1f)} .ds-e{box-sizing:border-box;border:1px dashed var(--app-label-secondary,rgba(60,60,67,.75));background:transparent}

narrative.overview:
**Creative North Star: "The Beit Midrash Shelf"**

Every day is a spine on a shelf of sefarim, and a prayer במניין earns its gold stamp. The system is a native iOS app first: Ionic in forced iOS mode, SF for every word, the system grouped ground, inset groups, a bottom tab bar, large titles that collapse on scroll, full RTL. On top of that native frame sit exactly two borrowed materials: a dark leather band that holds the large title and the date line, and a set of flat leather hues, one per prayer, with gold leaf as the only "done" mark.

The shelf is the one signature and it repeats at every scale: a 7-day mini shelf at the trailing edge of each row on היום, a row of tiny spines under each day number in לוח, and full-period shelves per prayer in סטטיסטיקה. A slot is always one of four states (gold, bare leather, empty dashed, nothing), stamped in place; rows never move and nothing reflows.

Density is Operate-mode: one tap per prayer, one-handed, seconds at a time. Numbers live in hairline-ruled tables with tabular figures, not in card stacks or charts. Everything is flat colour; the only shadows are the native segmented-control thumb and the inset bands that paint gold onto a spine.
keyCharacteristics: Native iOS skeleton (grouped ground, inset groups, large title, tab bar) with a dark leather shell band.
One fixed leather hue per prayer, identical on every tab.
Gold leaf is the only completion mark; bare leather means prayed ביחידות; a dashed empty slot means unmarked.
The shelf repeats at three sizes as the system's single signature.
Flat colour only: no grain, texture or gradient.

rules.name: The Fixed Hue Rule
rules.body: A prayer's leather is the same on every tab, every table and every shelf. A new surface showing a prayer uses that prayer's hue class, never a new colour.

rules.name: The Gold Means Minyan Rule
rules.body: Gold appears on data only as the done state: a spine stamped for a prayer במניין or a day of learning, and the gold text of the selected במניין segment. Never use gold to decorate a neutral or partial state.

rules.name: The Deep Fill Rule
rules.body: Anything filled behind gold-leaf text takes `--hue-deep`, which does not lighten in dark mode. Only spines take the lightened `--hue`.

rules.name: The Native Type Rule
rules.body: SF only, at iOS text-style sizes. Labels above groups are sentence-case footnote in secondary label colour; no uppercase, no tracking, no display face.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every number renders with tabular figures (set on body) so counts line up in tables and never jitter when they change.

rules.name: The Flat Leather Rule
rules.body: Leather and gold are flat fills. No grain, texture, noise, gradient or sheen on the band, the spines or anything else.

dos: **Do** show a prayer's state as a mark in a fixed slot: gold spine, bare leather, or empty dashed slot.
**Do** reuse the shelf when a new surface shows a prayer over time, at one of the three established sizes.
**Do** put anything filled behind gold-leaf text on `--hue-deep` so it holds contrast in dark mode.
**Do** present numbers in hairline-ruled tables with tabular figures, row header leading and value trailing at 600.
**Do** stamp in place: a change animates only the slot that changed, and rows never move or reflow.
**Do** keep every touch target at least 44px and honour reduced motion.
donts: **Don't** add grain, texture, noise or gradients to the leather or gold; both are flat fills.
**Don't** mark a row's prayer with a coloured border along the row edge; hue lives in spines, the selected segment and the table key.

**Don't** use the habit-tracker idiom of green checkmarks, flames or heat grids for completion; completion is the gold spine. (The native checkbox in the Torah check is an input, not a completion badge.)
**Don't** give a prayer a colour other than its leather, or let one leather stand in for another.
**Don't** stack statistics into cards or charts; use the ruled tables and shelves.
**Don't** introduce a display face or a custom type scale; SF at iOS text-style sizes only.
